description: A dense continuous elongated mass of LOW SHRUBS and moss groundcover. A long asymmetrical tapered hedgerow-shaped bank, filled entirely with overlapping leafy dark green shrubs, creeping moss, tiny ivory flowers and fern leaves; a few SMALL mossy stones embedded within foliage. Solid lush foliage THROUGHOUT its centre, absolutely no central clearing or bare soil. Irregular natural leafy silhouette, tallest shrubs at left, tapering low ground cover at right. Original classic MMORPG detailed pixel art, elevated three-quarter overhead view, muted moss and jade green, subdued cream flowers, subdued weathered grey rocks. Transparent background surrounds foliage. NO circular shape, NO ring, NO bare dirt, NO open centre, NO path, NO planter, NO pedestal, NO border wall, NO trees, NO ground tile, NO diorama. One connected low vegetation mass for a natural pond bank.
